Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added four rotating short post-trade messages for Common and Uncommon deliveries. Rare, Epic and Legendary prizes now use dedicated reactions, and multi-prize trades choose the line for the highest rarity delivered.
